stem: When do asthma exacerbations tend to peak with rhinovirus circulation?
explanation: Late autumn to early spring is the period when asthma exacerbations tend to peak with rhinovirus circulation.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because asthma exacerbations are described as peaking during rhinovirus circulation in late autumn to early spring.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because late spring only does not match the seasonal peak described.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because mid-summer only is not the period associated with rhinovirus-related exacerbations.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because early summer to mid-autumn excludes the peak period described.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the pattern given is seasonal and linked to rhinovirus circulation.
